mcq.q: Which word means 'with' in bi-yadii?
mcq.explanation: bi means 'with', so bi-yadii is 'with my hand'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "touch your nose"?
mcq.explanation: اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ (ilmis anfaka) means touch your nose.

mcq.q: What does at-taawilatu Sagiira mean?
mcq.explanation: taawila is table and Sagiira means small.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "I am a pupil (boy)."
mcq.explanation: أَنَا تِلْمِيذٌ (anaa tilmiidh) means: I am a pupil (boy).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا أَبِي mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: هَذَا أَبِي (haadhaa abii) means: This is my father.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter خ make?
options: kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
mcq.explanation: The letter خ makes the sound kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ mean?
options: May you be well every year.
Do you have a party? (to a boy)
mcq.explanation: عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ سَعِيدٌ (ʿiid miilaad saʿiid) means: Happy birthday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ أُمِّي mean?
options: I have a brother and a sister.
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ أُمِّي (haadhihi ummii) means: This is my mother.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word جَوٌّ (jaww) mean?
mcq.explanation: جَوٌّ (jaww) means weather.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الشَّمْسُ حَارَّةٌ (ash-shamsu haarra) means: The sun is hot.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word رِيحٌ (riih) mean?
mcq.explanation: رِيحٌ (riih) means wind.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ mean?
mcq.explanation: آكُلُ الْخُبْزَ (aakulu l-khubza) means: I eat bread.

mcq.q: Which Arabic instruction means 'sit down'?
mcq.explanation: ijlis means sit down. qif means stand up.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ mean?
options: My grandfather is old (big in age).
mcq.explanation: جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ (jaddii kabiir) means: My grandfather is old (big in age).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word بَالُونٌ (baaluun) mean?
mcq.explanation: بَالُونٌ (baaluun) means balloon.

mcq.q: How many letters are in السبت (as-sabt) including alif and laam?
mcq.explanation: The letters are alif, laam, siin, baa and taa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: النَّافِذَةُ نَظِيفَةٌ (an-naafidhatu nadhiifa) means: The window is clean.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "My hand is small."
mcq.explanation: يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ (yadii Sagiira) means: My hand is small.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter د?
mcq.explanation: The letter د is called daal.

mcq.q: Which letter begins the word taawila?
mcq.explanation: طَاوِلَةٌ begins with the heavy letter Taa.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي mean?
options: In the room there is a bed.
In the kitchen there is a table.
mcq.explanation: هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي (haadhihi ghurfatii) means: This is my room.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَمْسِ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَمْسِ is read amsi and means yesterday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "grandfather"?
mcq.explanation: جَدٌّ (jadd) means grandfather.

mcq.q: What is a good aim in a reading contest?
options: To read as loudly as possible
To read as fast as possible
mcq.explanation: Accuracy and smoothness matter more than speed.

mcq.q: How wide should the space between two words be?
options: About the width of one letter
mcq.explanation: A small even space keeps words apart without breaking the sentence.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا تِلْمِيذَةٌ (anaa tilmiidha) means: I am a pupil (girl).

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable بَ?
mcq.explanation: بَ is read ba.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word حَارٌّ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: حَارٌّ is read haarr and means hot.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ mean?
options: The chair is at the door.
The key is in the cupboard.
Do not play with the knife.
mcq.explanation: الْكُرْسِيُّ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ (al-kursiyyu ʿinda l-baab) means: The chair is at the door.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ض?
mcq.explanation: The letter ض is called Daad.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word اسْمِي read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: اسْمِي is read ismii and means my name is.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) mean?
mcq.explanation: مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) means lamp.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The wind is strong."
mcq.explanation: الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ (ar-riihu qawiyya) means: The wind is strong.

mcq.q: What is the difference between ح (Haa) and خ (khaa)?
options: khaa has a dot above and Haa has none
Haa has a dot above and khaa has none
mcq.explanation: khaa is Haa with one dot above.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أُغْنِيَةٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أُغْنِيَةٌ is read ughniya and means song.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ الْعَصِيرَ (uhibbu l-ʿasiira) means: I like juice.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "mother's brother"?
mcq.explanation: خَالٌ (khaal) means mother's brother.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "We look after the environment."
mcq.explanation: نُحَافِظُ عَلَى الْبِيئَةِ (nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a) means: We look after the environment.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "And the rain is from the sky."
mcq.explanation: وَالْمَطَرُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ (wal-maTaru mina s-samaa'i) means: And the rain is from the sky.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word خُضَارٌ (khudaar) mean?
mcq.explanation: خُضَارٌ (khudaar) means vegetables.

mcq.q: How does the Arabic comma ، differ from the English comma?
mcq.explanation: The Arabic comma and question mark are reversed because the script goes right to left.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence لِي يَدَانِ mean?
mcq.explanation: لِي يَدَانِ (lii yadaani) means: I have two hands.

mcq.q: Which is a sign of fluent speaking?
options: Clear sounds and a steady pace
mcq.explanation: Fluency means smooth speech with clear sounds, steady pace and good intonation.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word نَعَمْ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: نَعَمْ is read naʿam and means yes.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ص?
mcq.explanation: The letter ص is called Saad.

mcq.q: What can you do when you meet an unknown word in a text?
options: Use the sentence around it to guess its meaning
mcq.explanation: Clues around a word help to infer its meaning.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَاءٌ (maa') mean?
mcq.explanation: مَاءٌ (maa') means water.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي mean?
mcq.explanation: أَكْتُبُ بِيَدِي (aktubu bi-yadii) means: I write with my hand.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word نَعَمْ (naʿam) mean?
mcq.explanation: نَعَمْ (naʿam) means yes.

mcq.q: Which is the correct order for the sentence 'The pen is in the bag'?
mcq.explanation: The item comes first, then the position word and the place.

mcq.q: Which day has the letter jiim in its name?
mcq.explanation: الجمعة contains jiim (ج).

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ mean?
options: In the room there is a bed.
In the kitchen there is a table.
mcq.explanation: فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ (fii l-ghurfati sariir) means: In the room there is a bed.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word اِسْمَعْ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: اِسْمَعْ is read ismaʿ and means listen.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ mean?
mcq.explanation: الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ (al-maa'u nadhiif) means: The water is clean.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word الْأَرْبِعَاءُ (al-arbiʿaa') mean?
mcq.explanation: الْأَرْبِعَاءُ (al-arbiʿaa') means Wednesday.

mcq.q: What does the phrase al-hamdu lillaah express?
mcq.explanation: al-hamdu lillaah means 'thanks be to God' and is often said when answering 'How are you?'.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "mouth"?
mcq.explanation: فَمٌ (fam) means mouth.

mcq.q: Which word means 'above'?
mcq.explanation: fawqa means above. taHta means under, fii means in and ʿalaa means on.

mcq.q: What does aghsilu wajhii mean?
mcq.explanation: aghsilu means I wash and wajhii means my face.

mcq.q: Where should you write the Arabic name of a drawing?
options: Under the drawing, from right to left
In the margin from left to right
mcq.explanation: Labels are written neatly from right to left.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "Thursday"?
mcq.explanation: الْخَمِيسُ (al-khamiis) means Thursday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "oranges"?
mcq.explanation: بُرْتُقَالٌ (burtuqaal) means oranges.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) mean?
mcq.explanation: مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ (maʿa s-salaama) means goodbye.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الْحَلِيبَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَشْرَبُ الْحَلِيبَ (ashrabu l-haliiba) means: I drink milk.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "river"?
mcq.explanation: نَهْرٌ (nahr) means river.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ب make?
mcq.explanation: The letter ب makes the sound b as in bag.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "lamp"?
mcq.explanation: مِصْبَاحٌ (misbaah) means lamp.

mcq.q: Which line of the poem means 'My nose smells'?
mcq.explanation: anf is nose and yashummu means smells.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter ه?
mcq.explanation: The letter ه is called haa.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word أَغْلِقِ الْبَابَ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: أَغْلِقِ الْبَابَ is read aghliqi l-baab and means close the door.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "Sunday"?
mcq.explanation: الْأَحَدُ (al-ahad) means Sunday.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word أُسْبُوعٌ (usbuuʿ) mean?
mcq.explanation: أُسْبُوعٌ (usbuuʿ) means week.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word قِفْ (qif) mean?
mcq.explanation: قِفْ (qif) means stand up.

mcq.q: Which day ends with taa marbuta (ة)?
mcq.explanation: الجمعة ends with ة.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word غَدًا read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: غَدًا is read ghadan and means tomorrow.

mcq.q: Which sound does the Arabic letter ل make?
options: kh, a throat sound like the ch in loch
mcq.explanation: The letter ل makes the sound l as in lamp.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ mean?
mcq.explanation: أَشْرَبُ الْمَاءَ (ashrabu l-maa'a) means: I drink water.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "flower"?
mcq.explanation: زَهْرَةٌ (zahra) means flower.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word هَدِيَّةٌ (hadiyya) mean?
mcq.explanation: هَدِيَّةٌ (hadiyya) means gift.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word كِتَابٌ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: كِتَابٌ is read kitaab and means book.

mcq.q: Which sound is made at the back of the throat like the ch in the Scottish word 'loch'?
mcq.explanation: The letter khaa makes the throat sound kh.

mcq.q: Which letter completes the word _ُور to make nuur (light)?
mcq.explanation: The word nuur (نُور) starts with nuun.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "finger"?
mcq.explanation: إِصْبَعٌ (isbaʿ) means finger.

mcq.q: Which style is quick and simple and used for everyday handwriting?
mcq.explanation: Ruqʿah is a short, quick style used in notes and everyday writing.

mcq.q: Which Arabic sentence means "The weather is cloudy."
mcq.explanation: الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ (al-jawwu ghaa'im) means: The weather is cloudy.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "I am well"?
mcq.explanation: أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ (anaa bi-khayr) means I am well.

mcq.q: What is the name of the Arabic letter و?
mcq.explanation: The letter و is called waaw.

mcq.q: What is the theme of a text?
mcq.explanation: The theme is the main subject of the text.

mcq.q: Why should a knife be kept out of the reach of small children?
mcq.explanation: Sharp items can hurt small children.

mcq.q: How is the Arabic word صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ read aloud in English letters?
mcq.explanation: صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ is read sabaahu l-khayr and means good morning.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ mean?
mcq.explanation: نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ (nahnu narqusu) means: We dance.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic word مُمْطِرٌ (mumtir) mean?
mcq.explanation: مُمْطِرٌ (mumtir) means rainy.

mcq.q: How do you read the syllable مُ?
mcq.explanation: مُ is read mu.

mcq.q: What is intonation?
options: The rise and fall of the voice when speaking
mcq.explanation: Intonation is how the voice goes up and down.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي mean?
options: In the room there is a bed.
In the kitchen there is a table.
mcq.explanation: أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي (uhibbu baytii) means: I like my house.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ mean?
options: I help my mother on Saturday.
I visit my grandmother on Friday.
I read a book on Sunday.
mcq.explanation: أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ (usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt) means: I help my mother on Saturday.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "day"?
mcq.explanation: يَوْمٌ (yawm) means day.

mcq.q: Which Arabic word means "face"?
mcq.explanation: وَجْهٌ (wajh) means face.

mcq.q: What is the short line ـ used for in Arabic letter tables?
options: It shows where a letter joins to another
mcq.explanation: The line is called a tatweel and shows joining.

mcq.q: What does the Arabic sentence أَخِي صَغِيرٌ mean?
options: My grandfather is old (big in age).
mcq.explanation: أَخِي صَغِيرٌ (akhii Sagiir) means: My brother is small.
